headline: This is a scam. Real toll agencies don't text links asking you to pay right away.

red_flags.why: The link goes to 'tollpay-renew.top', not your state's real toll website.
It threatens a $50 late fee 'today' to rush you.
It came from a random international number, not a short code.

what_to_do: Don't tap the link or reply.
If you're worried, log in to your toll account by typing the official website yourself.
Forward the text to 7726 (SPAM), then delete it.
if_already_acted: If you entered card details, call the number on the back of your card and ask for a new card.
Watch your statements for charges you don't recognize.
family_message: Heads up: texts saying you owe a toll and need to pay through a link are scams. Don't tap them!
